description: Review interface copy, one string per line, optionally prefixed with a type (button:, error:, empty:, tooltip:, placeholder:, heading:, toast:, label:). Checks each string for what its type needs (errors say what to do, empty states give a next step, buttons name the outcome), checks the set for inconsistency, and runs AI-writing tells over everything.

items.description: Or a list of strings or {text, type}

text.description: One string per line, e.g. 'button: Submit' or 'error: Invalid input'
